sections.title: Prerequisite: The Nature of Wave Interference
lecture_lines: Coherent light maintains constant phase relationships.

sections.title: The Mechanism of Diffraction
lecture_lines: Diffraction occurs when waves encounter apertures.
Gratings map spatial information through diffraction.

sections.title: Holography: Recording the Wavefront
lecture_lines: Photography records intensity, losing phase info.
Holography captures both amplitude and phase.
Object and reference beams overlap precisely.
The record becomes a complex hologram.

sections.title: Reconstruction: The Diffraction Gate
lecture_lines: Holograms function as complex diffraction gratings.
Reference light reconstructs the original wavefront.
The 3D scene emerges from flat media.
Diffraction effectively unfolds stored spatial information.

sections.title: Summary and Real-world Application
lecture_lines: Lasers provide the necessary coherent light.
Holography secures data and visual information.
